title: Extremely disappointed
body: I had been tracking my symptoms for over a year and I had just payed for my second premium subscription when my data got lost. I have been trying to get help via email and social media with any response at all and I have a very important consultation with the doctor’s team in four days and I was supposed to bring my data analysis and now I won’t be able to do it. I’ve been waiting for this appointment for a year and a half. I’ve explained all of this on my multiple emails to Bearable and still no answer… I feel like I lost hours and hours of my time that I spent tracking my symptoms for nothing.
author: ValienteAve

title: Pretty nice with some annoying little issue
body: Only got to use in one day lol but there’s this one issue that might make me uninstall is the buttons dont.. button. Like everything is nice and somewhat easy to understand by im pressing « continue » 1347 times and nothing happens, the cross, nothing, might make me change my mood to irritated 😭other then that its pretty good already

title: Best mental health tracking app
body: Never ever wrote a review on the apple before. The team is ALWAYS updating the app to add new features or make the interface more friendly in a relevant way. I can only speak for myself but they understand their users so well and seem genuinely so benevolent as opposed to other wellness apps that appear figures and profit driven. Thank you so much
author: aryr3

title: Awesome free app
body: Free version works great, it’s helping me track my migraines. They’re not too pushy on the paid version, no pop ups, and free version is functional enough that I didn’t get frustrated. I think it’s helping keep me accountable and stay on top of logging my days

author: a playef

title: Ça a l’air bien!
body:
Le remplissage des symptômes est très bien, facile et rapide car les cas sont bien prévus (reporter son alimentation, ses symptômes, ses médicaments etc.)
Mais je n’ai pas encore accès aux statistiques comparatives (il faut + de temps) donc je ne peux pas encore juger.
Je trouve que les statistiques sont difficiles à configurer il faudrait plus d’aide ou d’exemples.
Aussi c’est dommage que la période d’essai soit trop courte pour pouvoir expérimenter les statistiques.
Enfin j’ai vu qu’on pouvait exporter les données, ce qui est indispensable, mais quelle est la compatibilité de ce fichier? Est ce un tableau Excel? Ça manque de clarté.
author: pomme4827
